tasks.instruction: MUSE-62: Independent pre-implementation tests of docs/engineering/CONNECTED_PORTAL_AUTHORING.md using current compileConnectedCoverWorld and moveRegionProbe on cloned connected-global fixture documents. Allowed ONLY portal-authoring-truth.test.js and docs/qa/muse62-portal-authoring.md. No kernel/app repairs or new authoring API implementation. Build a small deterministic corpus: atomic final graph with two new anchors plus one pair; valid E3/S3 centre crossing with transported camera and reverse crossing; invalid occupied endpoint, radius/frame mismatch, duplicate ID; a two-pair swap that is valid as a final graph but whose intermediate graph is invalid; migrating a baseScene connection into envelope when an endpoint becomes cover-owned; a compiled but obstructed destination that movement refuses (compiler success is not proof of walkability). Use explicit chart/frame coordinates, fixed seeds if needed, no unexplained random search. Read relevant portal contract/code only; no giant archive. Pin expected IDs/region/frame/clearance from independent construction where possible. If a contract claim is false, report the counterexample and do not repair it. Run your focused test only; no full suite/browser/queue from clone. Include one isolated fail-demo or intentionally invalid graph that proves the checks can fail. Report under 500words with commands, host and limitations. No commits/pushes/agents.
